rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the large bird of prey.

example.english: That eagle is circling over the mountaintop.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 jing1 hai2 saan1 deng2 dou6 pun4 syun4

rows.note: Golfers use this term for a score of two under par on a hole.

example.english: I got an eagle on this hole, so lucky.
example.traditional: 呢洞我打咗老鷹，真係好彩。
example.jyutping: ni1 dung6 ngo5 daa2 zo2 lou5 jing1 zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2
